package verify

import "fmt"

// The must-trip fixture for the assignment arm.

// A string literal straight into a Recorded field.
func writeRawLiteral() LegSummary {
	return LegSummary{
		Tool:  "stryker",
		Error: "stryker blew up",
	}
}

// A composed string into a Recorded field — the shape that would put a tool's
// own output back on disk.
func writeRawComposed(tool string, head string) LegSummary {
	var ls LegSummary
	ls.Error = fmt.Sprintf("%s failed:\n%s", tool, head)
	return ls
}

// err.Error() is not the carrier. It is the exact assignment this phase
// replaced at verify.go's record-and-continue site.
func writeRawErrorMethod(err error) LanguageRun {
	return LanguageRun{Error: err.Error()}
}
